title: Upload compile_commands fails with ENOTFOUND artifact upload error on Windows runner
signature: Failed to CreateArtifact: Unable to make request: ENOTFOUND|Network

failed_jobs.name: Build / Build
failed_jobs.symptom: Build completed successfully; the 'Upload compile_commands' step failed with a DNS resolution error (ENOTFOUND) when contacting the GitHub Actions artifact service.

key_errors:
2026-10-21T23:17:20.2884219Z ##[error]Failed to CreateArtifact: Unable to make request: ENOTFOUND
If you are using self-hosted runners, please make sure your runner has access to all GitHub endpoints: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/hosting-your-own-runners/managing-self-hosted-runners/about-self-hosted-runners#communication-between-self-hosted-runners-and-github
root_cause: The 'Upload compile_commands' step (using ababushk/upload-artifact) failed because the self-hosted Windows runner could not resolve the DNS hostname for the GitHub Actions artifact upload service (ENOTFOUND), a transient network/DNS infrastructure error unrelated to the build or the PR's code changes. The build itself completed successfully (CMake configure/build/install, Pack Artifacts, Contrib build all succeeded); only the artifact upload step after a successful build failed.
reproduction_steps: N/A - this is a transient network/DNS resolution failure on the self-hosted Windows runner infrastructure, not reproducible via local code changes. Rerunning the job would likely succeed if runner network connectivity to GitHub's artifact endpoints is restored.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed 'Build / Build' job; this is a transient infrastructure issue, not a code defect.

If ENOTFOUND failures on self-hosted Windows runners recur frequently, escalate to the CI infrastructure team to investigate DNS resolution reliability for the artifact upload endpoints from these runners.

Consider adding automatic retry logic (e.g., exponential backoff) around the upload-artifact action invocation for compile_commands and similar best-effort artifact uploads to reduce noise from transient DNS blips.
prevention_strategies: Add a retry wrapper (with backoff) around non-critical artifact upload steps, and/or monitor self-hosted Windows runner outbound DNS/network health so recurring ENOTFOUND errors can be caught and remediated before they affect multiple post-commit runs.
historical_context: This is the second occurrence of this exact signature (first seen 2026-09-23 on run 35899229472, 'Upload Test Results fails with ENOTFOUND artifact upload error on Windows runner'). A related but distinct DNS/network failure (ECONNREFUSED instead of ENOTFOUND) was also seen once on 2026-10-20 (run 39398307178). All three incidents point to intermittent outbound network/DNS instability from self-hosted Windows runners reaching GitHub's artifact service, not to any code or configuration regression.
